passages.text: Huernia zebrina, the little owl or lifesaver cactus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae, native to Namibia, Botswana, northern South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Mozambique. It is a succulent, and has gained the Royal Horticultural Society's Award of Garden Merit.

Subtaxa
The following subspecies are accepted:
Huernia zebrina subsp. insigniflora (C.A.Maass) Bruyns
Huernia zebrina subsp. zebrina
